prompt: A note editor shows a live line count under its JTextArea. Complete countLines (an empty area is 0 lines, one trailing newline does not start a new line) and refreshLabel.
explanation: A JTextArea always hands back its content as one String with '\n' between lines, so counting lines is really string work rather than Swing work. Handling the empty string and a single trailing newline separately is what makes the count match what a user sees on screen. Because the same refreshLabel method is registered for insert, remove, and change events, the label stays correct no matter how the text is edited.
hints: Start with notes.getText(). If it is empty the answer is 0 -- handle that before anything else.
Use endsWith("\n") and substring to drop a single trailing newline, then count the newlines that remain.
The number of lines is the number of remaining '\n' characters plus one.
